title: NEW GAMES RELATED TO OLD AND NEW SEQUENCES
abstract: We detine an infinite class of 2-pile subtraction games, where the amount that can be subtracted from both piles simultaneously, is a function f of the size of the piles. Wythoti's game is a special case. For each game, the 2nd player winning positions are a pair of complementary sequenccs, some of which are related to well-known sequences, but most are new. The main result is a theorem giving necessary and sufficient conditions on f so that the sequences are 2nd player winning positions. Sample games are presented, strategy complexity questions are discussed, and possible further studies are indicated.
